hypotheses.name: Sectional anisotropy seed robustness expansion
hypotheses.method: Seeds 42/43/44 across immune/lung/external_lung; source/target/dual-axis disjoint splits at layer 11. Added sectional anisotropy and tangent-orientation edge descriptors over H70 with endpoint-swap, sectional-row-shuffle, and stratified label-permutation nulls (8 each).
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.03135 (25 rows); positive mean null-gap domain-splits=6/9; strict-positive rows=16/25
hypotheses.next_action: Recover external_lung dual-axis seed coverage and rerun only that hard slice with relaxed gene/sample thresholds to verify whether the negative single-row result persists.

hypotheses.name: Neighborhood-size scaling stability of anisotropy signal
hypotheses.method: Seed42 across immune/lung/external_lung at layer 11; source/target/dual-axis disjoint where evaluable. Computed H139-style deltas for kNN sizes {8,12,16} and compared each to endpoint-swap control to obtain delta-gain-vs-swap.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.03374 (24 rows); positive gain rows=19/24; positive split gains=6/8
hypotheses.next_action: Replicate k-scaling gains on seeds 43/44 and require cross-seed sign consistency before promoting this stability claim.

hypotheses.name: Strict max-null fragility audit for H139
hypotheses.method: Computed per-row strict margins against the maximum q95 across H139 null families (endpoint-swap, sectional-row-shuffle, label-permutation), then aggregated by domain and split.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=-0.00523 (25 rows); strict-positive rows=15/25; strict-positive domain-splits=3/9
hypotheses.next_action: Use strict-margin negatives to define a fail-slice rescue packet (external_lung plus lung source/target) rather than broad global tuning.
